## Core Diagnostic Checks (12 Signals, 0-100 Score)
- OAI-SearchBot explicit crawl permission in /robots.txt
- GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot access policy check
- /llms.txt presence and Markdown structure validation
- JSON-LD core entity check (Product, SoftwareApplication, LocalBusiness)
- Offer price, priceCurrency, and availability readability
- FAQPage structured Q&A citation readiness
- AggregateRating verified rating trust signal
- Title and meta description buyer-intent match
- Canonical URL and og:url consistency
- Semantic heading hierarchy (single H1 and descriptive H2s)
- First-screen plaintext pricing and purchase CTA visibility
- Sitemap XML and multilingual hreflang discovery tags
